title: AyurSafe Master Herb-Drug Interaction Evidence Table
source: AyurSafe draft.pdf, Section 6, Table: Master Herb-Drug Interaction Evidence Table (Curated, n=30)
scope_rule: STRICT SOURCE OF TRUTH: only these 30 curated records may produce a herb-drug interaction alert in the evidence-based HDI module.

records.mechanism: Induction of CYP3A4 and P-gp efflux pumps via PXR activation.
records.outcome: Cyclosporine whole-blood levels dropped ~47%, causing acute and chronic transplant rejection.

records.mechanism: Coordinate induction of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 clearance.
records.outcome: Drastic drop in INR, risking thromboembolic failure and acute ischemic stroke.

records.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: Additive serotonin reuptake inhibition.
records.outcome: Life-threatening emergency: rapid onset of serotonin syndrome.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Induction of first-pass hepatic CYP3A4.
records.outcome: 13–15% drop in estrogen levels, triggering breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure.

records.mechanism: Irreversible suicide inhibition of intestinal CYP3A4 by furanocoumarins.
records.outcome: AUC up 3.6-fold; severe myocyte destruction (rhabdomyolysis) and myoglobinuria.

records.mechanism: Inhibition of first-pass CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.
records.outcome: Tacrolimus blood levels spiked to 55.4 ng/mL, inducing severe acute nephrotoxicity.

records.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: Platelet-activating factor (PAF) antagonism by ginkgolides.
records.outcome: Prolonged bleeding times, elevating the risk of spontaneous or mucosal hemorrhage.

records.mechanism: Mixed: Induced metabolic clearance + GABA-antagonism by epileptogenic ginkgotoxin.
records.outcome: Fatal breakthrough seizures; subtherapeutic serum anticonvulsant levels.

records.mechanism: Mixed: No significant CYP-mediated pharmacokinetic effect in human trials.
records.outcome: No changes in INR, platelet aggregation, or warfarin pharmacokinetics in humans.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Upregulation of CYP3A4 activity.
records.outcome: Nifedipine Cmax dropped 53.4%, risking anti-hypertensive therapeutic failure.

records.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP3A5, and P-gp by curcuminoids.
records.outcome: Tacrolimus trough levels spiked to 29.9 ng/mL; acute calcineurin-inhibitor nephrotoxicity.

records.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: Synergistic platelet-activating factor and arachidonic acid inhibition.
records.outcome: Elevated risk of spontaneous or mucosal bleeding.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Inactivation-pathway enzyme inhibition.
records.outcome: Elevated prednisolone concentration and potentiated anti-inflammatory activity.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Chronic stimulation of hepatic CYP3A4 activity.
records.outcome: Ischemic stroke: INR dropped from therapeutic 2–3 down to 1.25.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Intestinal P-glycoprotein (MDR1) transporter induction.
records.outcome: Reduced oral bioavailability and systemic levels, risking immediate transplant failure.

records.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: Organosulfur antiplatelet constituents alter bleeding times.
records.outcome: Potentiated anticoagulant effects, elevating bleeding and bruising risk.

records.mechanism: Pharmacokinetic: Moderate in vitro inhibition of CYP2C9, CYP3A4, and UGT1A6.
records.outcome: Extremely isolated case of warfarin overanticoagulation; highly safe in human trials.

records.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: Intrinsic immunostimulant secondary metabolites activate immune response.
records.outcome: Pharmacodynamic antagonism of immunosuppression, risking acute autoimmune flares.

records.mechanism: CYP2C9 inhibition (via active flavonoids).
records.outcome: INR spikes >18–50; severe, fatal gastrointestinal and pericardial hemorrhage reported.

records.mechanism: Weak in vitro CYP2C9 inhibition; no pharmacokinetic effect observed in vivo.
records.outcome: Single case report of severe internal hemorrhage; controlled RCT shows no clinical or coagulation metrics effect.

records.mechanism: Intrinsic antiplatelet and hemostatic synergy.
records.outcome: Significantly elevated anticoagulant effects, spontaneous bleeding, and bruising risk.

records.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibition (via active lignans).
records.outcome: Delayed Tmax by 36.8% and significantly increased systemic tacrolimus exposures.

records.mechanism: CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolic pathway inhibition (via active polyphenols).
records.outcome: INR spiked to 3.84–4.1; hematuria and clinical overanticoagulation.

records.mechanism: CYP3A4 enzyme inhibition (via active kavalactones).
records.outcome: Clinical emergency: patient lethargy and transition into comatose state due to drug accumulation.

records.mechanism: OATP1A2 drug-transporter inhibition (via active catechins, primarily EGCG).
records.outcome: 85% drop in nadolol Cmax and AUC; complete failure of blood pressure control.

records.mechanism: CYP3A4 metabolic inhibition and intestinal P-gp efflux blockade.
records.outcome: Toxic drug accumulation; severe calcineurin-inhibitor clinical toxicity.

records.mechanism: Weak in vitro CYP3A4 inhibition combined with synergistic central GABA-agonist pharmacodynamics.
records.outcome: Enhanced sedative/hypnotic effects; alprazolam AUC increased by ~19%.

records.mechanism: CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolic pathway inhibition.
records.outcome: Significantly increased plasma AUC, elevated Cmax at steady state, and delayed clearance.

records.mechanism: CYP1A2 metabolic induction (via active rutaecarpine).
records.outcome: Systemic AUC decreased by 73% and plasma half-life reduced by 85% in animal models.

records.mechanism: CYP3A4 transcriptional induction (via active calycosin and formononetin).
records.outcome: Tacrolimus blood levels nearly halved; refractory nephrotic syndrome and complete clinical treatment failure.
